name: goals
description: What a persona, in one domain, is trying to achieve.

aiGuidance.purpose: The outcomes this persona wants in this domain, as short phrases. Jobs are the tasks done to reach them; goals are why. Problems are held when goals are blocked.
aiGuidance.extraction: Three to five short phrases in the persona's own terms, one per entry.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: Do not list features, products or solutions.
